rules.rationale: Macro equation defining the named filterBody proof term as the exact translated nested conditional; it introduces syntax and does not assert a separate mathematical fact.
Macro equation defining specialFilterStmts as the exact translated function body, including initialization, loop, and return.
Base equation of the structural allInts predicate on the empty value sequence.
Recursive equation defining allInts on a cons by the head sort test and the structurally smaller tail.
Defining equation for the named projection-domain predicate definedProjectInt in terms of the existing Int sort predicate.
Trusted simplification characterizing the definedness of the pre-existing partial Val-to-Int cast; Stage 1 does not first prove this exact #Ceil equation in a module that omits it.
Guarded defining equation for the fresh named proof term projectIntTotal in terms of the existing partial subsort cast.
Trusted reverse-orientation simplification from the pre-existing partial cast to projectIntTotal; its exact statement is not separately proved before the rule is compiled.
Defining collapse equation for projectIntTotal when its argument already has sort Int.
Structural normalization equation making the named projectIntTotal proof term idempotent.
Trusted simplification extending the pre-existing applyCmp symbol from a dynamically sorted Val to projected Int comparison; no rule-free Stage 1 proof establishes this exact twin first.

Trusted simplification extending the pre-existing applyBuiltin str operation to a dynamically sorted projected Int; Stage 1 compiles this rule before all proofs and supplies no exact prior derivation.
Equation defining the firstDecimalCode mathematical summary by selecting index zero of the supplied integer decimal representation.
Equation defining lastDecimalCode as the final code of the supplied integer decimal representation.
Equation defining firstDigitOdd as parity of the first decimal character code.
Equation defining lastDigitOdd as parity of the final decimal character code.
Equation defining the isSpecial summary as the conjunction of the threshold and two digit-parity predicates.
Base recurrence defining specialCount of the empty value sequence as zero.
Recursive defining case for specialCount that adds one when the integer head satisfies all three qualifying conditions.
Recursive defining case for specialCount that skips an integer head not greater than ten.
Recursive defining case for specialCount that skips a greater-than-ten integer whose first digit is not odd.
Recursive defining case for specialCount that skips an integer with an odd first digit but a non-odd last digit.
Recursive defining case making specialCount skip a non-Int head and continue on the structurally smaller tail.
